name: Rance 5D - Hitoribocchi no Onna no Ko -
original_name: ランス５Ｄ －ひとりぼっちの女の子－
source:
After fooling around too much and burning through all his funds, Rance reluctantly takes his slave, Sill, and his pet, Athena 2.0, with him on some adventuring work.

But while fighting through a dungeon, they get lost in the caves and can't find any way out...

After some trouble, they eventually arrive at a mysterious castle inhabited by youkai.

[From [url=https://mangagamer.org/rance/6/]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
兰斯玩得太过火，耗尽了全部资金，只好不情愿地带上奴隶希露和宠物雅典娜2.0，一起接下冒险工作。

然而在地下城战斗期间，他们迷失在洞窟中，怎么也找不到出口…

经历一番波折后，众人最终来到一座由妖怪居住的神秘城堡。

[摘自[url=https://mangagamer.org/rance/6/]MangaGamer[/url]]
